objective: Live interactive gaming verification: Open a web-based game in browser on DISPLAY=:0, navigate and click with Natural Mouse, play using both Keyboard and Mouse inputs, capture screenshots via Vision Coordinate Grid, and verify gameplay progress.

assignments.scope: Open an interactive web game (e.g. 2048 at https://play2048.co or Google Pac-Man at https://www.google.com/logos/2010/pacman/pacman10-hp.html or Chrome Dino at https://elgoog.im/t-rex/) in Firefox on DISPLAY=:0. Use capture_screen_with_grid to locate UI elements, use natural_mouse_click to start/focus/interact, use keyboard_press and keyboard_type to play consecutive moves, take before-and-after grid captures to verify score/gameplay advancement, and report with notify_coordinator_worker_idle.
